component.name: Claude Usage
component.summary: See how much Claude usage you have left, in your system tray

description.p: Claude Usage keeps your Claude session and weekly limits one glance away. A progress ring and the time until reset sit in your system tray; open the panel for weekly and per-model limits and exact reset times.

ul.li: Session usage and time until reset, always visible and refreshed every minute.
Weekly limits, per-model limits, and extra usage in the panel.
Context window usage for your most recent Claude Code session, read locally.
Sign in with your browser, or reuse your existing Claude Code login.

description.p: This is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
